integrity: The finite-grid norm identity is proved analytically from convolution, a Dirichlet-kernel factorization, and finite cosine sums. The verifier independently compares the closed form with direct kernel sums; numerical checks are not used as a substitute for the all-N proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the four consecutive frequencies on cyclic groups and the endpoint ell-one/ell-infinity operator norms. No arbitrary four-point-spectrum, longer-block, or intermediate-exponent theorem is claimed. An older equivalent formula under different terminology remains a literature risk.
title: Exact four-frequency Fourier projection norm on every cyclic group
